phases.title: Preparation

tasks.summary: Specify requirements, cost/permission boundaries and ownership.
Prepare module/task/state contracts and short Codex instructions.
Validate tooling, negative guard tests and truthful evidence.
Prepare a reviewed, locally closed milestone for publication.

acceptance: P00-A1: Product/cost/security/modular constraints documented.
P00-A2: Every phase has bounded tasks and testable acceptance.
P00-A3: Doctor, checks and preparation tests pass.
P00-A4: Input-hashed evidence and resume state exist.

phases.title: Local typed foundation

tasks.summary: Pin strict TypeScript/build/test/lint tooling; prove clean npm ci and add real typecheck/build/lint, dependency review and audit gates to CI/evidence. Begin dated provider/free-egress research without outreach or deployment.
Implement narrow contracts, domain model and schema/semantic/capability validation with bounded untrusted profile inputs; refine the threat model.
Add a stable typed RV-MODULE-NNN error catalog, redaction, injected clock/random/storage and compiler-backed import/re-export/alias boundary tests.
Implement minimal deterministic config output fixture and its negative tests.

Record dated capability, permission and free-egress findings in the existing sources/blockers; decide the exact allowed local P02 work and blocked live step. Unresolved external gates do not imply local foundation failure.

acceptance: P01-A1: Strict typecheck, lint, build, compiler-backed architecture tests and relevant tests pass; dependency licenses/provenance and audit findings are reviewed, with no unmitigated high/critical finding.
P01-A2: Invalid/unsupported input is rejected with stable error codes.
P01-A3: Pure core uses no provider APIs; deterministic fixture output is reproduced.
P01-A4: Feasibility checkpoint cites dated sources, actual missing prerequisites and the local/live boundary; no deployment permission is inferred from a flag or consent.

phases.title: Connection feasibility

tasks.summary: Separate VLESS parser from WS/TCP transport; test locally against controlled peers.
Prove stream bounds, cleanup, cancellation, timeout and reconnect behavior.
Revalidate the P01.05 capability/cost findings and applicable provider permission before live deployment; record non-sensitive evidence references, never permission documents or secrets.

Only with permitted free deployment: run an authenticated, bounded controlled trial with actual client/destinations; measure CPU/memory, egress, cost and viability. Do not expose a public admin panel.

acceptance: P02-A1: Protocol/stream negative and failure tests pass.
P02-A2: A real free permitted connection is demonstrated with environment/version evidence.
P02-A3: Provider permission and cost constraints are satisfied; no paid/unknown mandatory egress.

phases.title: One end-to-end subscription flow

tasks.summary: Create a user, independent connection credential and subscription token.
Complete one pinned client flow first, then both sing-box and Mihomo formatters; provide matching version/device-specific link/QR import and update instructions.
Test fetch, parse, real-device import, connection and subscription update.

Handle unsupported capabilities explicitly; retain minimal profile identity/source/revision/credential references and separate timed parse/import/connect/update observations, including stale and not_run.

acceptance: P03-A1: Create -> subscription -> import -> connect -> update succeeds.
P03-A2: Both claimed clients have actual compatibility evidence.
P03-A3: Unsupported capabilities never generate silently broken configs.

P03-A4: Profile history never reactivates obsolete credentials; imports are bounded and validated, and a pasted URL triggers no automatic fetch/activation. Live trials stay restricted until production security/recovery gates pass.

phases.title: Identity and revocation

tasks.summary: Refine the threat model against the actual design; implement single-owner admin bootstrap, secure sessions and recovery.
Select a maintained WebAuthn or password/TOTP solution after CPU/UX spike; no custom crypto.
Implement expiry, rotation, revocation and a measured active-session policy.
Test admin/subscription/connection isolation, request forgery, bounded login attempts and allowlisted admin audit events with bounded retention/redaction.

acceptance: P04-A1: Admin/subscription purpose isolation and recovery tests pass.
P04-A2: Expired/revoked credentials fail within the documented bound.
P04-A3: No shared/default password; no secrets in diagnostics.

phases.title: Safe changes and recovery

tasks.summary: Implement draft/validate/preview/atomic activate and safe config rollback.
Encrypt owner-controlled backups using vetted crypto; test fresh-install restore.
Preserve credential revocation across rollback/restore; fail safe if freshness is unknown.
Implement migrations with preflight, backup and failed-migration recovery.

acceptance: P05-A1: Invalid config never activates; rollback cannot revive revoked access.
P05-A2: Wrong-password/corrupt backup rejection and fresh-install restore pass.
P05-A3: Migration failure leaves a tested recovery route.

phases.title: UI and installation

tasks.summary: Implement polished Persian/English RTL mobile UI, simple/expert and light/dark/system.

Build status/users/subscription/profile/settings/recovery screens; reuse validation/compiler contracts for a bounded paste/validate/preview playground and staged diagnostics. Keep observation time/origin distinct from current connectivity.

Implement guided official install, inventory, idempotent resume and selective uninstall; provide downloadable offline help and instructions for an existing trusted connection, without a bundled relay.
Show capability, permission, privacy and quota estimates with timestamps.
Document the actual privacy inventory (field/purpose/readers/retention/deletion) in docs/PRIVACY.md; verify implementation and export redaction before beta.

acceptance: P06-A1: Run the novice/mobile/keyboard/RTL protocol in docs/TESTING.md; record observed completion, time, assistance and defects. Automated accessibility scores alone cannot pass human UX.
P06-A2: Repeated/interrupted installs avoid duplicate resources; unrelated resources survive removal.
P06-A3: Diagnostic export is previewed/redacted; status distinguishes last observation from current connection.
P06-A4: Offline help remains usable without reaching Cloudflare; interrupted setup resumes. Browser diagnostics respect available APIs and classify unobservable causes as unknown.
P06-A5: Privacy inventory matches actual fields/readers/retention/deletion; profile/config previews do not fetch, activate or leak credentials implicitly.

phases.title: Limited beta

tasks.summary: Test a small authorized beta on declared networks/devices/client versions.
Measure success/latency/throughput/reconnect and quota budgets against a controlled baseline.
Fix critical failures with regression tests and verify recovery/security.
Confirm all beta dependencies remain permitted and free.

acceptance: P07-A1: Publish the actual beta network/device/client-version matrix and denominators under docs/TESTING.md; distinguish observed coverage from untested combinations.
P07-A2: No unresolved critical security/recovery defect.
P07-A3: Cost and provider permission are still valid.

phases.title: Public release quality

tasks.summary: Review original/third-party licenses, SBOM, integrity/provenance and signed release process.
Test novice install/update/restore and alternate domain distribution without trusting compromised code.
Complete security/privacy/help text and verify artifact hashes from a clean build.
Publish only supported capabilities and measured limits.

acceptance: P08-A1: All required phase gates pass; provider/budget gate remains satisfied.
P08-A2: Release integrity, dependency licenses and restore/upgrade are verified.
P08-A3: No untested speed/UDP/always-on/reproducible-build promise.

phases.title: Measured reliability improvements

tasks.summary: Add compatible native client fallback/url-test with limited trusted profiles and bounded probes.
Add local network measurements and explainable deterministic advisor.
Tune by controlled A/B evidence; keep TLS/auth and privacy invariants.
Only add extra protocol/routing UI after demonstrated user need.

Optionally evaluate bootstrap tools/catalog/local integration against PROJECT R16: provenance/license/free-capacity, first-download access, enforceable destination/byte/time scope, verified TLS, expiry/revocation and bounded updates. Defer integration with reasons if gates or maintenance budget fail.

acceptance: P09-A1: Capability-specific fallback and stale/no-route cases pass real-core tests.
P09-A2: Probe overhead and switching behavior meet a measured budget.
P09-A3: Each recommendation is explainable and backed by observed data.

P09-A4: Bootstrap integration is either deferred with a documented reason or demonstrated against its trust, cost, scope and failure tests; it never becomes a required relay or blocks the core release.
